assumptions: FMJ direct hit at point blank: no falloff, ricochet or penetration
hostile instigator with no instigator tags; rules that need instigator or target tags are skipped

a hit takes the section of its triangle's slot as in Vehicle §3.1 (projectile and radial hits); unreachable names why no registered component can produce a slot key
hits_to_destroy counts hits through that slot until the main health reaches 0; null when it never does (no damage, or no route to the main health)

notes: Rotor blades ("no section"): their WDRotorCollision profile blocks bullets, but a blade hit finds no section and does nothing to the vehicle. Projectile sweeps ignore the blades. Hubs are normal hitboxes.

Only the gun mount is shown. The gun's own proxy (CC_Browning_Gun) attaches to a receiver_J bone that SK_Browning_Mounted doesn't have; with partial attachments not enabled (0x50EF920) it is likely never attached.

Damage state: every wheel deflated (state 1) or destroyed (state 2), Vehicle §3.2's wheel mesh swap. Destroyed shows the destruction mesh; deflated keeps the intact look but traces against the destruction mesh's collision (AlternativeCollisionHull, 0x5389A46), so both give this hitbox. Each wheel's slot is CC_Wheel, which is material 0 on the intact and destroyed collision meshes alike (assuming the hull keeps the destroyed mesh's material indices). A wheel deflates at TyreHealth / max ≤ 0.55 and is destroyed at TyreHealth ≤ 0 (0x537C580).

The turret housing's collision mesh (CC_WHL_08_TurretHousing) is authored in vehicle space, but the data attaches it at the turret socket like a socket-local mesh, so its hitbox sits about 2 m above the roof. Shown where the data places it; whether the game corrects this is not traced.
